verdict.rationale: Anthropic Skills ships a first-party meta-skill (skill-creator) for creating and iteratively improving skills, a repo SKILL.md template, and a formal Agent Skills specification covering directory layout and frontmatter. Plugin manifests provide a documented packaging path, and a runtime probe confirmed skill-creator installs cleanly as a spec-conformant folder. missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an agent actually authoring and packaging a new skill end to end, and explicit documentation that the meta-skill itself performs the packaging/distribution step.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill

citations.quote: A skill for creating new skills and iteratively improving them.
Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance.
Replace with description of the skill and when Claude should use it.
A skill is a directory containing, at minimum, a `SKILL.md` file
The `SKILL.md` file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.
The manifest file at `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` defines your plugin's identity: its name, description, and version.
